items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-10-13
items.q: I started playing with his dance band around 57. Mm-hmm. And started playing with his brass band, must have been around 58 to 59.

ctx.x: Mm-hmm. When did you start in with John? Hasn't it?

I started playing with John, I think I was in the hospital in 57. I started playing with his dance band around 57. Mm-hmm. And started playing with his brass band, must have been around 58 to 59. Mm-hmm.
So, who would he have in his dance band when you first joined?
